title: Cherubim
summary: Cherubim appear as heavenly beings associated with guarding, throne imagery, and sacred space.
background: Cherubim are connected to Eden’s guarded way, the ark, temple imagery, and visions of divine glory. They should not be reduced to sentimental angel images.
teachingHelp: Explain cherubim as majestic biblical beings tied to God’s holiness, throne, and guarded presence.
